summary.text: Nate Wadsworth is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 82, Oxford County, representing Brownfield, Fryeburg, Hiram, Lovell, and Porter.
The page lists committee service on Energy, Utilities and Technology.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Nate Wadsworth's education as Montana State (B.S., 2003).
The page lists Nate Wadsworth's occupation as Forestry Company Manager.
Listed affiliations include Fryeburg Fair- Trustee, Sacopee Rescue Director.
Nate Wadsworth lives in Hiram and has served 5 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
